ABOUT
AFCO
STEEL

AFCO STEEL is a specialized facility in the engineering, fabrication, treatment and erection of various heavy steel structural works and steel products. It is located in the second industrial Area in Jeddah. The AFCO Facility was established on an area 40000m2 with 25000m2 enclosed workshop.

It is a high tech facility, integrating Design, Fabrication, Surface treatment and Erection. Our Factory has all the standard tools, equipment and machinery as described in this profile.

To be recognized as a leading engineering and steel manufacturer, nationally and internationally.
